## BioCryst to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference


September 1, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.biocryst.com/node/28291/pdf)


RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V5fKrXz1U6rvpLvlRiiCyMQDqkJ0noYvhLy7hyUuhFHy9t46EIOeS6SjZ59uyx0BVzwpAiMvvY-etUVvz_R9OFKVHoTdrkLzYS-w4RLIxIK26Ug6a8l1Xr7xuVUq8eKU) (Nasdaq: BCRX) today announced that the company plans to present at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference in New York on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 9:15 a.m. ET.


The link to the live audio webcast and replay of the presentation may be accessed in the Investors & Media section of BioCryst’s website at[www.biocryst.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nbOAgBgGv8XSgNuGVJeU1-wWv3Xt8CFoplUkpLDJN2VMfoI9k8HOGO4O0d_cR_bnznKpd2rVIqkR7pCIs49AIZKWFhL9y1qQetidAaLKIzw=) .


**About BioCryst Pharmaceuticals**


BioCryst is a global biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing medicines for hereditary angioedema (“HAE”) and other rare diseases, driven by its deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with these conditions. BioCryst has commercialized ORLADEYO® (berotralstat), the first oral, once-daily plasma kallikrein inhibitor and is advancing a pipeline of potential first-in-class or best-in-class therapeutics for rare diseases.
